items.title: 66100_Bud Freeman oral history interview
items.q: Ramey Rainey told me that story

ctx.x: instrument, and put it in the man's face, and said, 'listen you so and so mother, you are going to take us on this bus.' The man said, 'All right, you can go and sit in the back,' because the man was terrified. So they sat in the back and Lester -- here they were, everybody was tense and frightened and Lester Young claps his hands together like a little seal and says, 'Shoot your pistol, baby, shoot your pistol.'
Ramey Rainey told me that story, and it is just like the man. He refused to be frightened and always had this wonderful sense of humor, yet very deep.
I don't know that I should take the liberty of telling these stories.
